name: LFM-ORBIT
_note: Dev controller button layout. Groups become tabs.

buttons.label: Dump Default Structure
buttons.description: Generates _struct_summary.txt based on the default groups in your summary bank.

buttons.label: Sync Summary Bank
buttons.description: Scans the repo for new/moved files and updates summary_bank.json without breaking custom groups.

buttons.label: Edit Summary Bank
buttons.description: Opens summary_bank.json in your default text editor.

buttons.label: Print Context Group
buttons.description: Prints a group's context directly to stdout for LLM consumption.

buttons.label: Install Full Runtime
buttons.description: Installs locked dependencies, fetches the trained Orbit GGUF, and starts the full local demo.

buttons.label: Start Web Dev
buttons.description: Starts the full local demo from already-installed dependencies.

buttons.label: Start Hosted Demo
buttons.description: Starts the browser-only hosted portfolio demo without the Orbit backend.

buttons.label: Clean Runtime State
buttons.description: Clears mutable runtime stores for a cold start without touching source-backed demo assets.

buttons.label: Verify Repo
buttons.description: Runs locked backend, frontend, hosted static-preview, and Playwright verification.

buttons.label: Install Dependencies Only
buttons.description: Installs locked dependencies and the trained model without starting a server.

buttons.label: Push Reviewed Changes
buttons.description: Commits only reviewed, pre-staged changes and pushes the current branch to the public LFM-ORBIT GitHub remote with upstream tracking. Stops on divergence or conflicts.

buttons.label: Pull / Sync
buttons.description: Fetches, prunes, and safely rebases the current branch from origin. Stops without choosing conflict sides or dropping a conflicted safety stash.
